item.description:
>Hoppip, Skiploom, and Jumpluff Event Live Now (March 9 - March 24, 2026)
https://www.pokemon.com/us/pokemon-news/play-a-limited-time-event-in-pokemon-pokopia-on-nintendo-switch-2

>F.A.Q

>Can I have more than one world in the same console?
Yes. You can have different saves for each profile. It's not like AC.

>What about cloud saves?
Yes. Unlike every other Pokémon game, this one does support cloud saves.

>Does it feature a real time clock? Can I change the console's date to progress faster?
Yes. There's no downside to moving forward or backward.

>Is my favorite Pokemon in?
List is still being updated https://www.serebii.net/pokemonpokopia/availablepokemon.shtml

>I didn't like ACNH, will I like this one?
Similarities with ACNH end at the UI; game is a lot faster, with more activities and a proper ~40h long story mode. If you've played DQ Builders 2, you know what you're getting into.

>Combat? Breakable tools?
No combat, no breakable tools. There's a stamina system in place, but it's very easy to manage.

item.description:
https://www.newsweek.com/lindsey-graham-draws-maga-anger-over-israel-comments-11651141
South Carolina Senator Lindsey Graham has sparked fierce backlash from big MAGA names after he professed his loyalty to Israel and said he was asking Americans to send their sons and daughters to the war in the Middle East.

"To all the antisemites, to all the isolationists…I’m not with you, I’m with Israel, I will be with Israel to our dying day," he said in a Fox News interview.

Later, while condemning what he called "double-dealing in the Arab world," he said: "I’m going back to South Carolina, I’m asking them to send their sons and daughters into the Mid East."

Several MAGA supporters have spoken out against Graham and his comments, and others he has made recently, with one calling him "traitorous" and conservative podcaster Megyn Kelly calling him a "homicidal maniac."

item.title: [ 31] Jello Thread
item.description:
I'm a /fit/fag and a poorfag and my building had boxes of beetroot they were giving away free so I grabbed a bunch. Beetroot is one of the best things you can eat for muscle recovery and gelatin is pretty much pure protein with documented results at healing bones and joints so I made beetroot jello to eat post workout. It's actually not bad.

I quartered the beets and cooked them in a covered roasting dish with water and salt for an hour, let them cool then peeled off the skins. Then boiled and mashed them in a pot of water till they disintegrated, then added more salt and unflavoured gelatine. Let the mixture cool then transfer to a container and refrigerate.

I just wanted to share this wacky creation. And to ask if any Anons have any other wild jello ideas? I like making jello.

I was going to add the contents of a couple of magnesium capsules and multivitamins to this mix but I figured it might interfere with the uptake of whatever is already naturally in the beetroot.

Next I think I want to buy a bag of frozen berries, boil them up with sugar and gelatine them for a more conventional jello creation.

This is how jello was made back in the old times.
